# Dangling Pages

The Wiki Emitter does not handle cases of dangling pages well, where a page's owner entity has been removed. This can lead to stale pages remaining on disk without regeneration or deletion.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/wiki/emitter.py` — `knowledge_compiler.wiki.emitter.WikiEmitter.emit`
